title: [GAP-6] Abuse and spam handling stops at relay rate limits
description: Review finding GAP-6: Abuse and spam handling stops at relay rate limits (lens GAP). Location: spec/10-relays.md:59, 665-683; spec/12-security.md:54-64; spec/04-access-control.md:62, 147, 157-161; spec/99-appendices.md:38 (the original cited :315; the file has 44 lines). Fix: The core gap is confirmed: there is no report type, no invitee-side DM consent, no CO-to-IO chain deregistration and no takedown handling. Grep for report, takedown and frank finds nothing relevant. Correct one claim: KeyPackage draining is already addressed. "The host rate-limits fetches to prevent a caller from draining a user's supply" (05:73, also 02:381). Unsolicited DM adds remain open. On fix item (1): Agora has no message franking, so the claim that an MLS-signature-based `AbuseReport` would be third-party verifiable needs the same external crypto review as Q1. State it as such, or drop "verifiable". `ChainDeregistration` fits S7 and Q6. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
